description: Grady says the clonejackers working Ironside Street are killing his business by killing his customers. Clear two of them out and bring back the flashlight cells they lifted off him.
name: The First Hour

objectives.desc: Head east out of the vats onto Ironside Street (follow the green GPS line — hit AUTO).
emotes: {who} steps out of the vat-house, blinking hard, and gets their bearings on the street.

objectives.desc: Put down 2 clonejackers preying on the newborns.
emotes: {who} drives a clonejacker back a step.

objectives.desc: Loot Grady's stolen cells off a downed clonejacker.
